Live on.Anomalies × Mutating Girl × Survival TPSSurvive a world crawling with Anomalies.The girl faces her fate, gun in hand—──────────■ STORY──────────Japan, the year 20██.Anomaly Zones suddenly appear without any sign.In search of her friend who went missing in an Anomaly Zone, 17 year old Reona Minazuki becomes a Diver for the government-backed Anomaly Zone Countermeasures Office.On her first Dive, as countless other Divers fall victim to the Zone, a strange power awakens within her.The sole survivor, she heads deep into the abyss of Anomaly Zones.Her friend's disappearance, the origin of Anomaly Zones, and the mystery of her powers— When all of it is finally revealed, what will she see—?──────────■ SYSTEM──────────Dive, Retrieve, ReturnWhile exploring Anomaly Zones, Reona has no choice but to engage strange creatures called "Anomalies" in combat.Manage your ammunition and carefully select what to retrieve as you make your way to extraction."【Anomaly Zone】 Combat and Dives - Investigation of Anomalous Spaces that Transcend the Laws of NatureAn apartment complex with inverted gravity, a twisted, writhing hallway, a shopping street that endlessly multiplies—Explore Anomaly Zones where various anomalous phenomena have occurred. - Gun Action and InventoryDestroy all Anomalies you encounter and carefully choose the right weapon for each battle.Items discovered on Dives can be brought back to Base and utilized. - Anomalization SkillsReona Minazuki can make use of 12 unique powers.They support gunfights, and can sometimes serve as powerful game-changers.【Base】 Replenish and Enhance - Gun Customization and ArtifactsUtilize attachments to customize each firearm and tailor them to various combat styles.Equip Artifacts retrieved from Anomaly Zones to improve your stats.Choose wisely when selecting equipment and ammo as you prepare for Dives. - Change into a Variety of CostumesGears are separated into nine parts, with each costume affecting Reona's stats.Outward appearance can be changed without affecting stats, making it possible to go on Dives in your favorite fashion. - Collect Info on Anomaly ZonesDefeat Anomalies to view Dive Reports detailing their ecology.Learn detailed information on the backgrounds and relationships of other characters through side missions.──────────■ CREATORS──────────Scenario: Romeo TanakaCharacter Design: MONComposer: Yuka KitamuraSoftware description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):【Pre-order Bonus】 - Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionReopen the toy chest and saddle up as Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie in Toy Story 3 Complete Edition, a 3D adventure based on the hit 2010 animated film, Toy Story 3. The updated game features improved graphics and a few new surprises in store. Play through authentic moments from the movie in Story Mode, or drop into the wild west sandbox of Woody’s Roundup in Toy Box Mode. In Story Mode, swap between Woody, Buzz, and Jessie as you play through iconic scenes from the film, including the train rescue, Operation Playtime, surviving the junkyard, and more. Harness each character's unique abilities, whether you need to swing on Woody’s pull string or use Buzz’s strength to throw the other toys long distances. You can even play in two-player co-op. Step out of Story Mode and into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. This fan-favorite, customizable mode drops you into the wild west of Woody’s Roundup. Like Story Mode, you play as Woody, Buzz, or Jessie, but in Toy Box Mode you can play however you want! Characters around town give you quests to complete, so you can earn gold and spend it on personalizing the town your way. Build, decorate and customize the buildings, dress up the townsfolk, and more. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also includes content that was previously restricted to certain versions of the game. Players can now play as the Evil Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode, and can access four additional Theme Packs to decorate their Toy Box. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition also features upgraded graphics, resolution, and framerate. FEATURES - Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back a fan-favorite game. - Relive key moments from the movie in Story Mode from Andy's room to Sunnyside Daycare. - Swap between Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and Jessie, each of with different abilities you’ll need to complete each level. - Dive into the sandbox in Toy Box Mode. Take on missions for your fellow toys, dress up the townsfolk, decorate buildings, and much more. - Play with a friend in local, two player co-op. Available in Story Mode or Toy Box Mode. - All versions now include previously exclusive content, such as the ability to play as Emperor Zurg in Toy Box Mode.Show morePublished byAtariDeveloped byDigital EclipsePlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-2)4K Ultra HDSingle playerShared/split screenOptimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesIncluded inDisney/Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double PackView game XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
